content.text: No non-solicitation, no-hire, or recruiting restriction exists anywhere in the document.

input.quote: Each party is responsible for the supervision, direction, and control of its respective personnel. IBM reserves the right to determine the assignment of its personnel.
input.rationale: Searches for "solicit", "hire", "employ" and "induce", plus review of the two candidate sections (§ 14.8 Personnel and § 14.16 Freedom of Action), confirm the Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-recruitment covenant binding Customer. § 14.8 addresses only supervision and assignment of each party's own personnel and subcontracting, and § 14.16 expressly confirms each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others. This matches the preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer), so no redline is warranted; the absence of any restrictive covenant benefits our party.
